items.text: nahi ye galat number hai
main nahin hu ye vyakti
galat aadmi hai
galat hai bhai
ye mera nahi hai
maine ye liya hi nahi

items.context: Can you please confirm your registered phone number?
items.text: ye number mera nahi hai

items.context: Please confirm the name on the account
items.text: nahi ye mera account nahi hai

items.context: Can you verify your address for verification?
items.text: ye address mere area ka nahi
main Ravi Kumar from Jaipur baat kar raha hu par ye account mera nahi hai
mera naam Anjali Sharma hai par jo number call kar raha hai wo galat hai
maine apne paas koi credit card ke paisa udhaar liya hi nahi
ye EMI jo wo bol rahe hain wo mere account ke hisab se match nahi karta
mera address Mumbai me hai aur ye jo zila bata rahe ho wo different hai
aap jo keh rahe ho wo galat hai mujhe koi collection wala notice nahi mila
ho sakta hai ki aapne galat person ko call kar liya hai mera naam Suresh hai aur address Delhi me hai

items.context: Are you sure the account is under your name?
items.text: maine kabhi bhi loan liya nahi hai ye jo aap bol rahe ho aapka data galat hai

items.context: Can you confirm your current city and name?
items.text: nahi sir ye galat number hai mera naam Pooja verma hai aur main Lucknow me rehti hu

items.context: Are there any recent transactions you do not recognize?
items.text: ye jo mujhe charges dikh rahe hain wo mera account se match nahi karte mujhe pata nahi inka

items.context: Can you confirm the details you have for the loan account?
items.text: main Sanjay Singh bol raha hoon par jo aap debt collection kar rahe ho wo kisi aur ka case hai

items.context: Please verify the phone number we have on record.
items.text: main Neha Mittal hoon aur Hyderabad me rahti hu ye jo phone number call kar raha hai wo mere paas nahi hai
maine kabhi bhi Is loan ke liye apply nahi kiya hai aur mera naam bhi us list me nahi hai jisme aap contact kar rahe ho
mera naam Rahul Jain hai aur main Bangalore me rehta hoon mujhe poora shak hai ki ye call galat person ke liye hai jo number aap dikh rahe ho wo mera nahi hai
main Sunita Gupta bol rahi hu aur mera address Delhi me hai par ye jo call aa raha hai vo alag sheher ke liye lagta hai aur mujhe lagta hai aapke pass galat details hain

items.context: Can you please confirm your full name and city of residence?
items.text: main aapko batana chahti hu ki mera naam Priya Singh hai aur main Pune me rahati hu to ye collection kis cheez ki baat ho rahi hai mujhe samajh nahi aa raha

items.context: Can you share more details about the loan account for verification?
items.text: kya aap thoda aur details de sakte hain kyunki main Abhishek Kumar hoon aur mera address Chennai hai mujhe lagta hai ki ye account kisi aur ka hai

items.context: Can you verify your account number and dues details again?
items.text: main Rajeshwari Patel bol rahi hu aur main Ahmedabad se hoon mujhe lagta hai ki aapne galat vyakti se baat kar liya hai kyunki maine kabhi bhi loan ke liye apply nahi kiya hai aur na hi koi dues hain mera account number bhi jisme aap call kar rahe hain wo mera nahi lagta hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: wrong_person - says the agent has the wrong person or number
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
